summary: Buildable, breathable coverage. A pressed powder foundation that delivers a velvety, natural-matte finish without the weight of liquids.
description: Flexible chromatic coverage. Engineered for quick application and portability, this powder foundation melds instantly with the skin’s natural oils to provide a seamless, non-chalky veil of color.
technical_overview: Offered at $36.0 for 12g, this KoColor FACE_POWDER is expertly formulated with Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Zinc Stearate, and Iron Oxides. It delivers a high-fidelity Neutral Sand color profile (`#E6C2A5`) and leverages sebum-adaptive pigments.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Swirl a dense brush into the compact and buff into the skin using circular motions.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Mist the face with setting spray immediately after application to melt the powder into a skin-like finish.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Utilizing synthetic fluorphlogopite ensures a smoother, more predictable particle size compared to natural mica.
